messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hi, thanks for the options! We can do the 42 days lead time you want. Our main offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. But 90 days payment is way too long for us, we can't do that. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €31.50 per unit. This option also has Lieferzeit 42 days. We are so excited about the chance to work together and build a strong partnership with you! Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Jana Procházková

messages.subject: HX shaft: commitment-backed pricing review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Our RFQ doc:20260923-70210-P05 specifies 4,200 pieces annually, providing a stable basis for production planning over the fixed two-year commitment.

Could you review €30.00 per piece DAP with 45-day payment and 35-day lead time against that commitment? If 35 days requires additional cost, please quote the same package at 42 days and explain the difference.

Your latest message both offers and rejects 90-day payment; please clarify which terms are authorized. If the proposed price exceeds your approval authority, could your pricing team review it and identify any scheduling efficiencies supporting a reduction?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: HX shaft: commitment-backed pricing review
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are so happy to work with you and really want to build a great partnership!

Our updated offer is a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

You mentioned 4,200 pieces a year, but please send over the actual delivery schedules so we can see if that helps with the price. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Also, our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days, but with overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
